primary_purpose: Provide a static read-only sample of the future simulation playback state so the web interface can render clock, speed, scrubber, delay propagation, and decision-preview controls without triggering simulation or optimization execution.

dissertation_scope.scope_note: The sample keeps the dissertation centered on delay propagation while preserving an extensible platform structure for future perturbation types.

play.disabled_reason: Read-only UI sample. No simulation clock execution is available from the browser.

pause.disabled_reason: The displayed state is already static and paused.

step_forward.disabled_reason: Future control only. It must not mutate the static sample.

step_backward.disabled_reason: Future control only. It must not mutate the static sample.

reset.disabled_reason: Reset is not available because no executable playback session exists.

speed_control.disabled_reason: Speed selection is a preview-only contract field until a safe execution backend exists.

timeline_scrubber.disabled_reason: The scrubber can be rendered but must not alter the sample state.

delay_propagation_view.dissertation_alignment: This view is centered on delay propagation and exposes how a local service delay can affect downstream tasks, route stability, feasibility, and future re-planning decisions.

decision_preview_binding.tradeoff_summary: The preview connects delay propagation to feasibility, performance, stability, and computational cost, but it does not execute or apply any decision.

ui_quality_requirements: The UI must clearly show that playback controls are disabled.
The UI must not imply that a simulation, solver, optimizer, or backend job has been executed.
The UI must preserve the delay propagation focus of the dissertation.
The UI must keep sample data deterministic so tests remain reproducible.
The UI must display playback state as inspection-only until a validated backend execution layer exists.
safety_requirements: Do not expose POST, PUT, PATCH, or DELETE behavior for this sample.
Do not trigger simulation execution from the browser.
Do not mutate files from the playback controls.
Do not claim that the selected policy has been operationally applied.
Do not use this sample as production dispatch output.
validation_rules: playback controls must be visible but disabled.
speed control must be visible but disabled.
timeline scrubber must be visible but disabled.
decision preview must be visible but disabled.
delay propagation must remain the primary dissertation focus.
conservative_note: This is a static read-only playback state sample. It is safe for UI rendering and testing only. It does not start, pause, advance, reset, or execute a simulation, and it does not apply any re-planning decision.
